author: NorthEast News Desk
body: Attleboro police are asking the public to help identify a masked man accused of robbing a South Attleboro donut shop while carrying a claw hammer.

Officers responded to a hold-up alarm at Vista Donuts, 1096 Washington Street, at about 5:08 a.m. Sunday, September 6. An employee told investigators that the man entered shortly after the shop opened, displayed the hammer and threatened to take what he wanted.

Police described the suspect as a thin white man, possibly in his late 20s or early 30s, about 5 feet 10 inches tall. Surveillance images released by the department show him wearing a surgical-style mask and carrying a backpack with distinctive colors. He was last seen running north on Washington Street.

No injuries were reported in the initial account, and police have not announced an arrest. Anyone who recognizes the suspect or has information about the robbery is asked to contact Attleboro Police Detective Alexander D’Agostino at 508-222-1212 and reference case number 26-75673.
dek: Police released surveillance images while searching for a masked man accused of threatening an employee with a claw hammer.
headline: Police seek suspect in Attleboro donut-shop hammer robbery
